EMS-CTRL-012.reason: Signed-commit expectations may depend on repository policy and contributor model.

EMS-CTRL-013.reason: Protected release tags are only applicable where release tags are used.

EMS-CTRL-014.reason: Issue-linkage enforcement depends on the approved change-management workflow.

EMS-CTRL-020.reason: License compliance requires an approved dependency-license policy and scan evidence; repository LICENSE-file presence alone is insufficient.

EMS-CTRL-025.reason: Unit-test detection by workflow naming may under-detect actual test execution.

EMS-CTRL-031.reason: Artifact presence alone may not prove the intended retention period.

EMS-CTRL-033.reason: Reproducible-build logic should be verified before accepting regressions from prior PASS/WARNING states.

EMS-CTRL-034.reason: Release manifest requirements should be confirmed for repositories that do not produce formal releases.

EMS-CTRL-035.reason: Checksum verification is typically applicable when distributable release artifacts exist.

EMS-CTRL-036.reason: Release signing is typically applicable when distributable release artifacts exist.

EMS-CTRL-037.reason: Artifact existence does not fully prove retention policy compliance.

EMS-CTRL-038.reason: Version-governance checks are typically applicable when release/version tags are used.

EMS-CTRL-039.reason: Release approval workflow applicability depends on whether the repository performs controlled releases/deployments.

EMS-CTRL-079.reason: Repository health is a composite control and should be adjudicated against the intended EMS assertions.
